headerDetails.name: Strict-Transport-Security
headerDetails.description: Forces browsers to use HTTPS, preventing protocol-downgrade attacks.

headerDetails.name: Content-Security-Policy
headerDetails.description: Restricts which resources the browser can load, blocking XSS attacks.

headerDetails.name: X-Frame-Options
headerDetails.description: Prevents the page from being embedded in an iframe, blocking clickjacking.

headerDetails.name: X-Content-Type-Options
headerDetails.description: Stops browsers from guessing the content type, preventing MIME-sniffing attacks.

headerDetails.name: Permissions-Policy
headerDetails.tip: Add a Permissions-Policy to restrict access to sensitive browser APIs.
headerDetails.description: Controls access to browser features like camera, microphone, and geolocation.

headerDetails.name: Referrer-Policy
headerDetails.tip: Set Referrer-Policy to no-referrer or strict-origin-when-cross-origin.
headerDetails.description: Controls how much referrer information is sent with requests.

headerDetails.name: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
headerDetails.tip: Add Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin to isolate your browsing context.
headerDetails.description: Isolates the browsing context, mitigating cross-origin attacks like Spectre.

headerDetails.name: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy
headerDetails.tip: Add Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy to control who can load your resources.
headerDetails.description: Prevents other origins from loading your resources, blocking cross-origin data leaks.

headerDetails.name: X-XSS-Protection
headerDetails.tip: Set X-XSS-Protection: 0 (if you have CSP) or 1; mode=block for older browsers.
headerDetails.description: Legacy XSS filter for older browsers. Modern sites use CSP instead.

headerDetails.name: Cache-Control
headerDetails.tip: For sensitive pages, ensure Cache-Control includes no-store or no-cache.
headerDetails.description: Prevents browsers from caching sensitive responses.
